components.label: support
responsibilities: Builders every shop test may share.
forbidden_responsibilities: Test cases, and importing any of them.

components.label: unit
responsibilities: One shop component at a time, without files on disk.
forbidden_responsibilities: Shared helpers, and reaching into another suite.

requires.rationale: Unit tests build their orders with the shared builders.

components.label: integration
responsibilities: Use cases against a real store directory.
forbidden_responsibilities: Shared helpers, and reaching into another suite.

requires.rationale: Integration tests compare what they read back with the shared builders.

rules.rationale: The test root holds its three suites and nothing beside them.
A test module no suite owns escapes every boundary below.
A suite imports another suite only where requires says so; absence forbids.
A helper class is shared, so it lives in support, not beside the test that first needed it.
Every package a test imports beyond the standard library is named by a rule.
The product under test is the one package every suite may import.
